drugs.name: Riluzole
drugs.mechanism: Inhibits presynaptic glutamate release and blocks voltage-gated sodium channels
drugs.efficacy: Extends survival and delays tracheostomy in ALS patients
drugs.adverse_effects: Asthenia, nausea, dizziness, elevated liver transaminases

drugs.name: Edaravone
drugs.mechanism: Free radical scavenger mitigating oxidative stress and motor neuron injury
drugs.efficacy: Slows functional decline (ALSFRS-R) in early-stage disease
drugs.adverse_effects: Bruising, gait disturbance, headache, allergic reactions

drugs.name: Tofersen
drugs.mechanism: Binds SOD1 mRNA causing RNase H-mediated degradation to reduce toxic SOD1 protein
drugs.efficacy: Lowers neurofilament light chain and slows progression in SOD1-ALS
drugs.adverse_effects: Procedural pain, CSF pleocytosis, myelitis, headache

drugs.name: Sodium phenylbutyrate / Taurursodiol
drugs.mechanism: Dual ER stress and mitochondrial dysfunction pathway inhibitor
drugs.efficacy: Mitigates neuronal apoptosis and functional loss

drugs.name: Masitinib
drugs.mechanism: Tyrosine kinase inhibitor targeting CSF1R and mast cell/microglial activation
